mapper.select: SELECT destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO, destroyRequest.DESTROY_TYPE, requestDetail.REQUEST_DESC, destroyRequest.DESTROY_NO FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST destroyRequest INNER JOIN DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_DETAIL requestDetail ON destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = requestDetail.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO WHERE destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = #{lastDestroyRequestNo} AND requestDetail.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'REQUEST' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_MAPPING destroyMapping JOIN DOCS_REQUEST request ON request.REQUEST_NO = destroyMapping.REQUEST_NO WHERE destroyMapping.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND request.DEPLOY_COMPANY_CD = #{sessionUser.companyCd} )

SELECT destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO, destroyFile.DESTROY_NO, destroyFile.DESTROY_FILE_SEQ, COALESCE(NULLIF(destroyFile.FILE_NM, ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(destroyFile.FILE_PATH, '^.*[\\/]', ''), '')) AS fileName FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST destroyRequest JOIN DOCS_DESTROY_FILE destroyFile ON destroyFile.DESTROY_NO = CAST(destroyRequest.DESTROY_NO AS TEXT) WHERE destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = #{lastDestroyRequestNo} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_MAPPING destroyMapping JOIN DOCS_REQUEST request ON request.REQUEST_NO = destroyMapping.REQUEST_NO WHERE destroyMapping.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND request.DEPLOY_COMPANY_CD = #{sessionUser.companyCd} ) ORDER BY destroyFile.DESTROY_FILE_SEQ

SELECT DISTINCT destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO, destroyFile.DESTROY_NO, destroyFile.DESTROY_FILE_SEQ, destroyFile.FILE_PATH, COALESCE(NULLIF(destroyFile.FILE_NM, ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(destroyFile.FILE_PATH, '^.*[\\/]', ''), '')) AS fileName, destroyMapping.REQUEST_NO, CASE UPPER(request.OBJECT_TYPE) WHEN 'DOC' THEN 'DOCUMENT' WHEN 'DOCUMENT' THEN 'DOCUMENT' WHEN 'DRAWING' THEN 'DRAWING' WHEN 'SW' THEN 'SW' WHEN 'PRODUCT_DOC' THEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT' WHEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT' THEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT' WHEN 'PRODUCT_SW' THEN 'PRODUCT_SW' WHEN 'SECP' THEN 'PRODUCT_SW' WHEN 'SECP_PARTDOC' THEN 'PRODUCT_SW' WHEN 'DXF' THEN 'DXF' WHEN 'PEERREVIEW' THEN 'PEER_REVIEW' WHEN 'PEER_REVIEW' THEN 'PEER_REVIEW' END AS objectType, destroyMapping.OBJECT_ID, COALESCE(CAST(destroyMapping.FILE_NO AS TEXT), '*') AS fileNo FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST destroyRequest JOIN DOCS_DESTROY_FILE destroyFile ON destroyFile.DESTROY_NO = CAST(destroyRequest.DESTROY_NO AS TEXT) JOIN DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_MAPPING destroyMapping ON destroyMapping.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO JOIN DOCS_REQUEST request ON request.REQUEST_NO = destroyMapping.REQUEST_NO WHERE destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = #{destroyRequestNo} AND destroyFile.DESTROY_FILE_SEQ = #{destroyFileSeq} AND request.DEPLOY_COMPANY_CD = #{sessionUser.companyCd} AND CASE UPPER(request.OBJECT_TYPE) WHEN 'DOC' THEN 'DOCUMENT' WHEN 'DOCUMENT' THEN 'DOCUMENT' WHEN 'DRAWING' THEN 'DRAWING' WHEN 'SW' THEN 'SW' WHEN 'PRODUCT_DOC' THEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT' WHEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT' THEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT' WHEN 'PRODUCT_SW' THEN 'PRODUCT_SW' WHEN 'SECP' THEN 'PRODUCT_SW' WHEN 'SECP_PARTDOC' THEN 'PRODUCT_SW' WHEN 'DXF' THEN 'DXF' WHEN 'PEERREVIEW' THEN 'PEER_REVIEW' WHEN 'PEER_REVIEW' THEN 'PEER_REVIEW' END IS NOT NULL ORDER BY destroyMapping.REQUEST_NO, destroyMapping.OBJECT_ID, fileNo
